findings.title: Callback with error parameter but no state
findings.detail: The callback validates state before it looks at the error parameter. An authorization error response that has no state is therefore refused as OIDC_BAD_REQUEST, not OIDC_EXCHANGE_FAILED. No scenario pins this down.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN the callback gets error=access_denied without a state parameter and with a valid login cookie THEN it answers 302 to /sign-in?error=OIDC_BAD_REQUEST and clears ursitoare_login.

findings.title: State longer than 128 characters
findings.detail: A state parameter of more than 128 characters is refused as OIDC_BAD_REQUEST, not OIDC_STATE_MISMATCH. No scenario covers this case.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN the callback gets a state parameter of 129 characters with a valid login cookie THEN it answers 302 to /sign-in?error=OIDC_BAD_REQUEST.

findings.title: Token endpoint 5xx maps to provider unavailable
findings.detail: exchangeCode maps a 4xx answer to OIDC_EXCHANGE_FAILED but a 5xx answer to OIDC_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE. The Code exchange scenario covers only 4xx refusals.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN the token endpoint answers status 500 to exchangeCode THEN the call rejects OidcError OIDC_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE with details { reason: "status", status: 500 }.

findings.title: Missing exp or iat claim reasons
findings.detail: A token without a numeric exp is refused with reason "expired", and one without a numeric iat with reason "iat". The Claim edges scenario covers only boundary values.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN a token signed by the issuer's key has no exp claim THEN verifyIdToken throws OidcError OIDC_TOKEN_INVALID with details.reason "expired".

findings.title: return_to is normalised, not returned as given
findings.detail: sanitizeReturnTo returns the WHATWG-normalised pathname, search and hash. Dot segments are resolved and non-ASCII characters are percent-encoded, so '/flows/../x' becomes '/x'. A raw-string implementation would differ on these inputs, and no scenario pins them down.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN sanitizeReturnTo gets a relative path holding dot segments such as `/flows/../x` THEN it returns the normalised path `/x`.

findings.title: Idle timeout boundary is inclusive
findings.detail: resolveSession treats a session as idle when now >= last_seen_at + idle_timeout_s, and the reaper uses <=. At exactly 1800 s the session is refused. The design says 'past', and the spec scenarios test only 1799 s and 1801 s.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN a session is resolved exactly 1800 s after its last use THEN resolveSession returns null, revokes it and removes its route.

findings.title: verifyCsrfToken does not check expiry, idle time or user state
findings.detail: verifyCsrfToken checks only revoked_at. A session past expires_at or idle, but not yet revoked, still verifies true, although the requirement says 'live session'. The logout route resolves the session first, so logout is not affected.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN verifyCsrfToken gets the current token of a session past its expires_at or idle limit that has not been revoked THEN it returns true.

findings.title: Issuer with an empty query marker or a trailing slash is accepted
findings.detail: 'https://idp.example/r?' has an empty search, so it passes and is kept as written. Discovery would then be fetched from 'https://idp.example/r?/.well-known/...'. A trailing slash likewise gives a '//' in the discovery path.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN URSITOARE_OIDC_ISSUER is `https://idp.example/r?` or `https://idp.example/r/` THEN loadConfig accepts it and keeps the text unchanged as oidc.issuer.

findings.title: task 1.1: bad client id rejection is not checked against its reason text
findings.detail: Task 1.1 asks for each rejection to be checked with its reason text. The 'bad id' case asserts only name, code and variable.
findings.suggested_fix: Add message: `URSITOARE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID: must be 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen` to the assertion.

findings.title: Callback with error parameter but no state
findings.detail: The callback validates state before it looks at the error parameter. An authorization error response that has no state is therefore refused as OIDC_BAD_REQUEST, not OIDC_EXCHANGE_FAILED. No scenario pins this down.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN the callback gets error=access_denied without a state parameter and with a valid login cookie THEN it answers 302 to /sign-in?error=OIDC_BAD_REQUEST and clears ursitoare_login.

findings.title: State longer than 128 characters
findings.detail: A state parameter of more than 128 characters is refused as OIDC_BAD_REQUEST, not OIDC_STATE_MISMATCH. No scenario covers this case.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN the callback gets a state parameter of 129 characters with a valid login cookie THEN it answers 302 to /sign-in?error=OIDC_BAD_REQUEST.

findings.title: Token endpoint 5xx maps to provider unavailable
findings.detail: exchangeCode maps a 4xx answer to OIDC_EXCHANGE_FAILED but a 5xx answer to OIDC_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE. The Code exchange scenario covers only 4xx refusals.

findings.title: Missing exp or iat claim reasons
findings.detail: A token without a numeric exp is refused with reason "expired", and one without a numeric iat with reason "iat". The Claim edges scenario covers only boundary values.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN a token signed by the issuer's key has no exp claim THEN verifyIdToken throws OidcError OIDC_TOKEN_INVALID with details.reason "expired".

findings.title: return_to is normalised, not returned as given
findings.detail: sanitizeReturnTo returns the WHATWG-normalised pathname, search and hash. Dot segments are resolved and non-ASCII characters are percent-encoded, so '/flows/../x' becomes '/x'. A raw-string implementation would differ on these inputs, and no scenario pins them down.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN sanitizeReturnTo gets a relative path holding dot segments such as `/flows/../x` THEN it returns the normalised path `/x`.

findings.title: Idle timeout boundary is inclusive
findings.detail: resolveSession treats a session as idle when now >= last_seen_at + idle_timeout_s, and the reaper uses <=. At exactly 1800 s the session is refused. The design says 'past', and the spec scenarios test only 1799 s and 1801 s.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN a session is resolved exactly 1800 s after its last use THEN resolveSession returns null, revokes it and removes its route.

findings.title: verifyCsrfToken does not check expiry, idle time or user state
findings.detail: verifyCsrfToken checks only revoked_at. A session past expires_at or idle, but not yet revoked, still verifies true, although the requirement says 'live session'. The logout route resolves the session first, so logout is not affected.
evidence: src/identity/oidc/sessions.ts: if (row === undefined || row.revoked_at !== null) return false;
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN verifyCsrfToken gets the current token of a session past its expires_at or idle limit that has not been revoked THEN it returns true.

findings.title: Issuer with an empty query marker or a trailing slash is accepted
findings.detail: 'https://idp.example/r?' has an empty search, so it passes and is kept as written. Discovery would then be fetched from 'https://idp.example/r?/.well-known/...'. A trailing slash likewise gives a '//' in the discovery path.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN URSITOARE_OIDC_ISSUER is `https://idp.example/r?` or `https://idp.example/r/` THEN loadConfig accepts it and keeps the text unchanged as oidc.issuer.
